name: Whipped Ricotta Bowl with Caramelized Onions, Mushrooms, Kale & Egg

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onions and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and starting to brown, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
3 bunches kale
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: When the onions are golden, add mushrooms, more oil, salt, and pepper to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are soft and onions are caramelized, 7-9 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half of the parsley to the bowl with the kale. (Set remaining parsley aside for serving.)
Add kale and parsley to the pot in handfuls, waiting for kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring frequently, until the kale is tender, 2-3 minutes.
Add vinegar and more salt to the pot, then stir to combine. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 eggs
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place ricotta, cream, salt, and pepper in a blender. Blend on high until smooth, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (15 oz) pkg ricotta cheese
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) heavy whipping cream
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide whipped ricotta between bowls; top with veggies, reserved parsley, and eggs. Enjoy!
